ils.name: Paper test ILT-Z branch valve concept
human_remaining_actions: Review plotted branch valve placement and estimated valve dimensions.
Review P/S connection label visibility and connector locations.
Review high-strain marker location before accepting the concept for test recording.
Replace typical dimensions with project-specific branch valve, connector, and wall data before final engineering use.
Run FEA or validated strain model before treating strain estimate as design value.

design_basis.strain_estimate_basis: screening estimate using EDIKB trend awareness; not FEA
design_basis.optimization_target: reduce header and branch strain by containing branch valve inside GD-ST and avoiding unjustified F2/F2D stiffness

associations.purpose: Vertical branch connector anchored to top frame using sliding support intent.
